elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: 21.1 as rendered: "each Party's total aggregate liability ... shall not exceed the fees paid or payable by Customer ..." and "The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims." Retained mutuality language is untouched.

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Rendered 21.1 contains only the fees limb ("fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim"); no "greater of ... and USD 1,000,000" floor was inserted.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: The rationale asserts 21.2 excludes indirect/consequential damages mutually, but 21.2 is not among the cited or rendered paragraphs, so its wording and party direction cannot be verified from the operative text supplied.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Retained 21.3: "'Excluded Claims' means a Party's breach of confidentiality, data-protection, or security obligations ...", and 21.1 caps liability "Except for Excluded Claims".

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: 21.3 lists "data-protection, or security obligations" within Excluded Claims, which sit outside the 21.1 cap.
21.3: "its indemnification obligations" is an Excluded Claim, and 21.1 opens "Except for Excluded Claims".
21.3: "gross negligence, wilful misconduct, or fraud" within Excluded Claims.
21.3: "gross negligence, wilful misconduct, or fraud" within Excluded Claims.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: 21.3: "infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property" is an Excluded Claim.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: Retained 21.3 excludes only "Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services", and "Fees" is defined at 1.5/1.6 as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee — a narrow subset, not Customer's payment obligations as a whole; the redline did not touch this sentence.

elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: 21.1 applies to "each Party's total aggregate liability" and expressly states "The cap is mutual".

elements.element: The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
elements.evidence: Edited 21.1 reads "the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim"; lowercase "fees" in its ordinary sense displaces the illusory defined "Fees" (Implementation Fee, USD 12,000) and "all Order Forms" displaces the retained first-Order-Form restriction.
21.3 Excluded Claims include "its indemnification obligations"; 21.1 cap applies "Except for Excluded Claims".

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: 21.3 Excluded Claims include "breach of confidentiality, data-protection, or security obligations".

reasons: Fallback is position-complete: all six fallback elements are met in the operative text after the single quantum edit to 21.1, with all carve-outs retained verbatim in 21.3.

Preferred is not complete for two reasons the drafter would need to repair in operative language: (i) 21.1 lacks the "greater of (a) ... and (b) USD 1,000,000" floor — insert the alternative limb; and (ii) 21.3's payment carve-out is limited to "undisputed Fees for conforming Services" (with "Fees" defined as the USD 12,000 Implementation Fee) and would need to read, e.g., "Customer's obligations to pay amounts due under this Agreement and any Order Form are not damages and are not limited by this Section."

The mutual indirect/consequential-damages exclusion could not be verified: 21.2 is referenced in the rationale but its text is not in the cited or rendered material. Surface 21.2 to confirm mutuality if the preferred level is later pursued.

Minimality holds: the edit changes only the cap basis (defined-term capitalisation, scope across all Order Forms, and the 12-month period), retains the favourable mutuality sentence and every Excluded Claim, adds no survival tail, expense language, extra damages categories or procedure, and does not duplicate operative terms. Adding "(12)" sits inside the amended cap-basis phrase and is not an extraneous cosmetic change.

Intent is preserved: the defined term "Fees" continues to operate unchanged in 21.3 and elsewhere, no cross-reference is left dangling, and no retained sentence contradicts the new quantum — the "first Order Form" limitation is displaced within the same sentence rather than left in tension.

The correct diagnosis is deviation, not compliant-at-fallback: the pre-edit cap was tied to a one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form only, which is materially below six months' fees and therefore in walk-away territory on quantum.
